about: AuthZEN cases for the embedded PEP (#46): one table, run offline by src/authzen_test.rs in local mode against a stub PDP, and live by scripts/live_iya_sts.py --authzen through a central and a local PEP of each application, which must answer every case alike and as `expect` says. Each policy is ALFA for iya-sts's import-alfa; `references` are PolicyIdReferences the live run adds with the editor (this ALFA dialect has none); `xacml` is the document iya-sts stored for it, which the offline stub serves. `expect` is what the host sees: Permit (with the obligations handed to it), Deny, or Unavailable. `knownLocalDefect` marks a case the local PEP is known to get wrong: the offline run requires it to be still wrong (so a fix shows up as a failure that asks for the mark to go), and the live run ignores the mark.

policies.name: az-root
alfa: namespace azroot {
attribute act { category = actionCat id = "urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:action:action-id" type = string }
attribute rtype { category = resourceCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:resource-type" type = string }
attribute protocol { category = environmentCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:protocol" type = string }
attribute app { category = environmentCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:application" type = string }
attribute acr { category = subjectCat id = "urn:example:az:acr" type = string }
attribute amr { category = subjectCat id = "urn:example:az:amr" type = string }
attribute clearance { category = subjectCat id = "urn:example:az:clearance" type = integer }
attribute emailVerified { category = subjectCat id = "urn:example:az:email-verified" type = boolean }
attribute orgUnit { category = subjectCat id = "urn:example:az:org-unit" type = string }
attribute staff { category = subjectCat id = "employeeType" type = string }
attribute classification { category = resourceCat id = "urn:example:az:classification" type = string }
attribute amount { category = resourceCat id = "urn:example:az:amount" type = double }
attribute ownerRegion { category = resourceCat id = "urn:example:az:owner-region" type = string }
attribute labels { category = resourceCat id = "urn:example:az:labels" type = string }
attribute expires { category = resourceCat id = "urn:example:az:expires" type = dateTime }
attribute reason { category = actionCat id = "urn:example:az:reason" type = string }
attribute channel { category = environmentCat id = "urn:example:az:channel" type = string }
attribute riskScore { category = environmentCat id = "urn:example:az:risk-score" type = integer }
policyset azRoot {
id = "urn:example:az:root"
apply firstApplicable
target clause protocol == "authzen"
policy azDocs {
id = "urn:example:az:docs"
apply firstApplicable
rule readPublic { permit target clause act == "read" target clause rtype == "document" target clause classification == "public" }
rule readInternal { permit target clause act == "read" target clause rtype == "document" target clause classification == "internal" target clause acr == "urn:example:az:mfa" }
rule readOther { deny target clause act == "read" target clause rtype == "document" }
rule approveInvoice { permit target clause act == "approve" target clause rtype == "invoice" target clause amount <= 1000.0 target clause clearance >= 2 }
rule approveOther { deny target clause act == "approve" }
rule exportReport { permit target clause act == "export" target clause labels == "exportable" target clause ownerRegion == "eu" target clause channel == "web" target clause riskScore < 50 }
rule audit { permit target clause act == "audit" target clause staff == "auditor" }
rule archive { permit target clause act == "archive" target clause emailVerified == true target clause orgUnit == "records" target clause expires > dateTime("2030-01-01T00:00:00Z") }
rule publish { permit target clause act == "publish" target clause acr[mustbepresent] == "urn:example:az:mfa" }
rule vote { permit target clause act == "vote" target clause amr == "hwk" }
rule justify { permit target clause act == "justify" target clause reason == "incident" }
rule about { permit target clause act == "about" target clause app == "authzen-docs" }
rule sign {
permit
target clause act == "sign"
on permit { obligation "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:obligation:step-up" { "acr_value" = "phr" } }
rule share {
permit
target clause act == "share"
on permit { obligation "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:obligation:notification" { "to" = "owner@example.test" "body" = "shared with you" } }

policies.name: az-shared-folders
alfa: namespace azfolders {
attribute act { category = actionCat id = "urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:action:action-id" type = string }
attribute rtype { category = resourceCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:resource-type" type = string }
policy azSharedFolders {
id = "urn:example:az:shared-folders"
apply firstApplicable
rule list { permit target clause act == "list" target clause rtype == "folder" }

policies.name: az-ledger-shared
alfa: namespace azledgershared {
attribute act { category = actionCat id = "urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:action:action-id" type = string }
attribute rtype { category = resourceCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:resource-type" type = string }
policy azLedgerShared {
id = "urn:example:az:ledger-shared"
apply firstApplicable
rule view { permit target clause act == "view" target clause rtype == "entry" }
rule erase { deny target clause act == "erase" }

policies.name: @FGA_POLICY@
alfa: namespace azledger {
attribute act { category = actionCat id = "urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:action:action-id" type = string }
attribute rtype { category = resourceCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:resource-type" type = string }
attribute clearance { category = subjectCat id = "urn:example:az:clearance" type = integer }
attribute stage { category = environmentCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:fga:stage" type = string }
policyset azLedger {
id = "@FGA_POLICY_ID@"
apply firstApplicable
policy azLedgerPost {
id = "urn:example:az:ledger-post"
apply firstApplicable
rule post { permit target clause act == "post" target clause rtype == "entry" target clause clearance >= 3 }
rule postOther { deny target clause act == "post" }
rule reconcile { permit target clause act == "reconcile" target clause stage == "access" }
